title: YSK: Meta Muse is giving away 1B free tokens
author: tastelikepeach
selftext:
If you haven't tried Muse (Meta's AI assistant app) yet, you can claim 1B free tokens with this code:

\`8S5T4D\`

How to redeem:

1. Download the Muse app (iOS/Android) or sign up at muse.ai

2. Mobile: Settings → Redeem token · Web: Settings → General → Usage → Redeem invite code

3. Enter the code and confirm — 1B tokens land in your account

Do it within 48 hours of joining, the redeem option disappears after that.

Full disclosure: I get 1B tokens too when someone uses my code, so we both win. Limited uses.
